tasks.name: 新向量修复
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
// ═══ L0/L1 向量异常定点清洗 + 自动补齐缺漏 ═══
// 规则：仅清理 L1 与 L0 异常向量；若存在 L2/模型指纹/锚点失败等超出范围的错误，立即报错中止！
(async () => {
  if (window.__LWB_VECTOR_AUTO_REPAIRING__) {
    console.info('[Info] 向量自动修复任务正在进行中，跳过本次执行');
    return;
  }
  window.__LWB_VECTOR_AUTO_REPAIRING__ = true;

  const toast = (m, t = 'info', timeOut = 5000) => {
    window.toastr?.[t]?.(m, '向量修复', { timeOut });
  };

  try {
    const { getContext } = await import('/scripts/extensions.js');
    const ctx = getContext();
    const chatId = ctx?.chatId;
    const chat = ctx?.chat || [];
    if (!chatId || !chat.length) {
      toast('❌ 未打开有效聊天', 'error');
      return;
    }

    const BASE = '/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary';
    const [cs, ss, dg, svi, evi, ct, cfg, emb, db, lex, crp, si] = await Promise.all([
      import(`${BASE}/vector/storage/chunk-store.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/storage/state-store.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/utils/vector-input-digest.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/pipeline/state-vector-input.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/pipeline/event-vector-input.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/pipeline/chunk-text.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/data/config.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/utils/embedder.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/data/db.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/retrieval/lexical-index.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/pipeline/chunk-repair.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/pipeline/state-integration.js`),
    ]);

    // ── 阶段一：全量状态检测 ──
    console.info('[Info] 正在执行全量向量状态校验...');
    const vectorCfg = cfg.getVectorConfig();
    if (!vectorCfg?.enabled) {
      toast('❌ 向量检索未启用', 'error');
      return;
    }

    const currentFp = emb.getEngineFingerprint(vectorCfg);
    const meta = await cs.getMeta(chatId);
    const fpMismatch = Boolean(meta?.fingerprint && meta.fingerprint !== currentFp);

    const [storedChunks, chunkVecs, stateVecs, evVecs] = await Promise.all([
      cs.getAllChunks(chatId),
      cs.getAllChunkVectors(chatId),
      ss.getAllStateVectors(chatId),
      cs.getAllEventVectors(chatId),
    ]);

    const atoms = ss.getStateAtoms() || [];
    const events = ctx.chatMetadata?.extensions?.LittleWhiteBox?.storySummary?.json?.events || [];

    // 1. L1 状态检测
    const storedChunksByFloor = new Map();
    for (const c of storedChunks) {
      if (!storedChunksByFloor.has(c.floor)) storedChunksByFloor.set(c.floor, []);
      storedChunksByFloor.get(c.floor).push(c);
    }

    const l1DriftFloors = [];
    const l1OutFloors = [];
    for (const [floor, list] of storedChunksByFloor.entries()) {
      if (floor >= chat.length) {
        l1OutFloors.push(floor);
        continue;
      }
      const curChunks = ct.chunkMessage(floor, chat[floor]);
      if (curChunks.length !== list.length) {
        l1DriftFloors.push(floor);
        continue;
      }
      list.sort((a, b) => a.chunkIdx - b.chunkIdx);
      const isMismatch = curChunks.some((cur, idx) => {
        const stored = list[idx];
        return !stored || cur.chunkId !== stored.chunkId || cur.textHash !== stored.textHash;
      });
      if (isMismatch) l1DriftFloors.push(floor);
    }

    const chunkById = new Map(storedChunks.map(c => [c.chunkId, c]));
    const chunkVecById = new Map(chunkVecs.map(v => [v.chunkId, v]));

    const l1OrphanVecIds = chunkVecs.filter(v => !chunkById.has(v.chunkId)).map(v => v.chunkId);
    const l1StaleVecIds = [];
    for (const v of chunkVecs) {
      const c = chunkById.get(v.chunkId);
      if (!c) continue;
      if (v.sourceHash && v.sourceHash !== dg.inputDigest('chunk', c.text)) {
        l1StaleVecIds.push(v.chunkId);
      }
    }

    // 2. L0 状态检测
    let l0FailedFloors = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < chat.length; i++) {
      if (!chat[i] || chat[i].is_user) continue;
      const st = ss.getL0FloorStatus(i);
      if (st?.status === 'failed') l0FailedFloors++;
    }

    const atomById = new Map(atoms.filter(a => a?.atomId).map(a => [String(a.atomId), a]));
    const l0DanglingAtomIds = stateVecs.filter(v => !atomById.has(String(v.atomId))).map(v => v.atomId);
    const l0StaleAtomIds = [];
    for (const v of stateVecs) {
      const a = atomById.get(String(v.atomId));
      if (!a) continue;
      const wantSrc = dg.inputDigest('state', a.semantic);
      const wantRel = dg.inputDigest('relation', svi.buildRAggregateText(a));
      if (v.sourceHash && (v.sourceHash !== wantSrc || (v.rVector && v.relationHash && v.relationHash !== wantRel))) {
        l0StaleAtomIds.push(v.atomId);
      }
    }

    // 3. L2 状态检测
    const evById = new Map(events.filter(e => e?.id).map(e => [e.id, e]));
    const evVecById = new Map(evVecs.map(v => [v.eventId, v]));
    const l2EventsNoVec = events.filter(e => e?.id && evi.buildEventVectorText(e) && !evVecById.has(e.id));
    const l2DanglingVecs = evVecs.filter(v => !evById.has(v.eventId));
    const l2StaleVecs = [];
    for (const v of evVecs) {
      const e = evById.get(v.eventId);
      if (!e) continue;
      if (v.sourceHash && v.sourceHash !== dg.inputDigest('event', evi.buildEventVectorText(e))) {
        l2StaleVecs.push(v.eventId);
      }
    }

    // ── 阶段二：严格安全校验（非 L0/L1 向量错误立即阻断报错） ──
    const outOfScopeErrors = [];
    if (fpMismatch) {
      outOfScopeErrors.push(`[指纹不匹配] 模型变更 (当前: ${currentFp} vs 记录: ${meta?.fingerprint})，需在面板执行完整重建`);
    }
    if (l0FailedFloors > 0) {
      outOfScopeErrors.push(`[L0锚点错误] 有 ${l0FailedFloors} 楼锚点提取失败，属于LLM层错误而非单纯向量损坏`);
    }
    if (l2EventsNoVec.length > 0) {
      outOfScopeErrors.push(`[L2事件错误] 有 ${l2EventsNoVec.length} 个事件缺失向量`);
    }
    if (l2DanglingVecs.length > 0) {
      outOfScopeErrors.push(`[L2事件错误] 有 ${l2DanglingVecs.length} 个已删事件的孤儿向量`);
    }
    if (l2StaleVecs.length > 0) {
      outOfScopeErrors.push(`[L2事件错误] 有 ${l2StaleVecs.length} 个事件向量摘要过期`);
    }

    if (outOfScopeErrors.length > 0) {
      console.info('❌ [安全拦截] 检测到超出 L0/L1 向量范围的异常，已中止删除操作：');
      for (const err of outOfScopeErrors) {
        console.info(`  - ${err}`);
      }
      toast('❌ 存在超出范围的异常（见控制台），安全拦截已中止', 'error', 8000);
      return;
    }

    // ── 阶段三：仅清洗 L1 / L0 异常向量 ──
    const targetL1Floors = [...new Set([...l1DriftFloors, ...l1OutFloors])];
    const targetL1VecIds = [...new Set([...l1OrphanVecIds, ...l1StaleVecIds])];
    const targetL0AtomIds = [...new Set([...l0DanglingAtomIds, ...l0StaleAtomIds])];

    const hasErrorsToClean = targetL1Floors.length > 0 || targetL1VecIds.length > 0 || targetL0AtomIds.length > 0;

    if (!hasErrorsToClean) {
      console.info('[Info] 未发现损坏的 L0/L1 向量，跳过清洗直接检查补齐');
    } else {
      console.info(`[Info] 开始清洗：L1漂移/越界楼 ${targetL1Floors.length}、L1孤儿/过期向量 ${targetL1VecIds.length}、L0孤儿/过期向量 ${targetL0AtomIds.length}`);

      // 1. 清理 L1 漂移与越界楼（连块带向量删）
      for (const floor of targetL1Floors) {
        await cs.deleteChunksAtFloor(chatId, floor);
      }

      // 2. 清理 L1 孤儿向量与过期向量
      if (targetL1VecIds.length > 0) {
        await db.chunkVectorsTable.where('[chatId+chunkId]').anyOf(targetL1VecIds.map(id => [chatId, id])).delete();
      }

      // 若修改了正文楼层，词法索引需失效
      if (targetL1Floors.length > 0) {
        await lex.invalidateLexicalIndex();
      }

      // 3. 清理 L0 异常向量（精准删除向量，锚点文本 stateAtoms 绝对保留）
      if (targetL0AtomIds.length > 0) {
        await ss.deleteStateVectorsByIds(chatId, targetL0AtomIds);
      }

      console.info('✅ [Info] L0/L1 异常向量清理完毕');
    }

    // ── 阶段四：触发 LWB “补齐缺漏” ──
    console.info('[Info] 正在调用 LWB 向量补齐缺漏...');

    let buttonTriggered = false;
    
    // 方案 C：若界面按钮未找到或被禁用，直接调用底层的官方补齐管道兜底
    if (!buttonTriggered) {
      console.info('[Info] UI 按钮未打开，使用官方底层管道直接触发补齐');
      toast('🛠️ 正在后台补齐缺漏向量...', 'info');

      // 补 L1
      const l1Result = await crp.repairMissingChunks({ chatId, chat, vectorConfig: vectorCfg });
      console.info(`[Info] L1 补齐完成: 补充 ${l1Result?.repaired ?? 0} 条`);

      // 补 L0
      const l0Result = await si.vectorizeMissingStateAtoms(chatId, null, { vectorConfig: vectorCfg });
      console.info(`[Info] L0 补齐完成: 补充 ${l0Result?.vectorized ?? 0} 条`);

      toast('🎉 向量清洗与补齐缺漏已全部完成', 'success');
    } else {
      toast('🚀 已清洗异常并成功点击「补齐缺漏」', 'success');
    }

  } catch (err) {
    console.info('[Info] 任务执行发生异常:', err);
    window.toastr?.error(`任务异常: ${err?.message || err}`, '向量修复');
  } finally {
    window.__LWB_VECTOR_AUTO_REPAIRING__ = false;
  }
})();
<</taskjs>>
